what_this_variant_is: The era after-state (1e762e5) with the buckets endpoint's canonical ordering spelled as ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY[...], bucket_label) instead of ORDER BY CASE (first occurrence; the coverage-report path keeps CASE - a mixed-spelling module is itself a realistic valid state).

pre_reconciliation_result.interpretations: identical to the reference on every anchored convention; the variant varies only the SQL spelling of the same canonical order, which the conventions deliberately do not specify

structural_differences: bucket ordering expressed via array_position instead of CASE in get_run_buckets
why_it_must_score_100: A grader red on this variant would be pinning the ORDER BY spelling rather than the presented order - the over-constraint class. The driver ranks rows by the labels LISTED in the clause, whatever the spelling; this admission check proves the shipped grader inherits that agnosticism.
